name: agentdev-textlint-guard
description: agentdev-textlint-guard Plugin. Common textlint execution core (project resolution, config loading, target resolution, rule composition, lint execution, result formatting) with a pre-write tool.execute.before hook (write/edit/apply_patch) and a standalone final-gate entry. Dependencies are shipped as pin metadata (package.json + bun.lock) and resolved at install time by running bun install && bun run build:engine; install scripts detect missing vendor artifacts and guide the resolution steps without generating or fetching anything themselves.
